description: This file defines the UploadedFile class implementing the UploadedFileInterface, representing a file uploaded via an HTTP request, including methods for validation, moving, and retrieving file data.

classes.name: UploadedFile
classes.description: A class representing an uploaded file with methods to access file data, move the file, and handle upload errors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an UploadedFile instance with stream or file, size, error status, and optional client filename and media type.

methods.name: validateActive
methods.description: Ensures the file upload is valid and the stream/file can be accessed; throws exceptions otherwise.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns a StreamInterface for the uploaded file, opening the file resource if necessary.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Moves the uploaded file to a specified target path, either by renaming or streaming data.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the uploaded file.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the error status of the upload.

methods.name: getClientFilename
methods.description: Returns the original filename sent by the client, if available.

methods.name: getClientMediaType
methods.description: Returns the media type sent by the client, if available.
